recognize_zh: 低中倍周邊血抹片中淋巴球明顯增多，多為核濃縮、帶切口或裂溝的小型淋巴球，對照視野中央唯一一個嗜中性球，顯示絕對淋巴球增多，符合百日咳。
features: Increased lymphocytes, clearly outnumbering the single neutrophil in the field
Predominantly small lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm
Irregular nuclear contours with clefts and indentations; dense mature chromatin
Occasional slightly larger lymphocyte with more cytoplasm; no blasts
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at medium power shows a relative and apparent absolute lymphocytosis, with numerous lymphocytes and only one neutrophil in the field. Most lymphocytes are small, with scant cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei showing clefts or indentations; a few are slightly larger with more cytoplasm. No blasts, smudge cells, or atypical large lymphoid cells are identified, and red cells and platelets appear normal. Findings are suggestive of the reactive small-lymphocyte lymphocytosis of Bordetella pertussis infection.

ddx.vs: CLL shows monotonous round lymphocytes with smudge cells in older adults and a clonal CD5+/CD23+ B-cell population on flow cytometry.
Lymphoblasts have fine chromatin, nucleoli, and often cytopenias, whereas these lymphocytes have mature condensed chromatin.

ddx.dx: Leukemic mantle cell or follicular lymphoma
ddx.vs: These adult lymphomas have clonal B cells (cyclin D1+ or CD10+), while pertussis lymphocytosis is polyclonal, T-cell rich, and pediatric.
